subject: maths
question: A profit of 19% is made on goods when a discount of 15% is given. What profit will be made when a discount of 25% is given?
solution:
**Given:**

A profit of 19% is made on goods when a discount of 15% is given

**Concept used:**

Profit is calculated on Cost Price.

And the discount is calculated on Market Price.

**Formula used:**

P = ( (100space +space profitspace Percentage)/(100)) × CP 

SP = CP + Profit

Market price - discount = Selling Price 

**Calculation:**

Let the Market price be 100 unit

Selling price = 100 - 100 × 15/100

⇒ 100 -15

⇒ Rs 85

So the cost price = 85 × 100 / 119

⇒ 500 / 7

In 2nd case , 

Selling price = 100 - 100 × 25/100

⇒ 100 -25

⇒ Rs 75

Profit = 75 - 500/7

⇒ 25 / 7

So profit percentage = (25/7)/(500/7) × 100

⇒ 100 /20 = 5%

**∴ 5% profit will be made.**
